name: Fleet Backups
description: Backs up the nodes this management node manages, on their own schedules. Each node does the work through its own backup engine — chain, envelope, upload, local sweep — while this decides when, prunes the shelf beforehand, and dispatches one job per due node. These are this management node's copies, under its own recovery key; a site's own backups are separate and unaffected. Node slots are spread across a window so a fleet does not upload all at once. The same pass proves the backups it takes: every listing is checked against each backup's own manifest (the shelf check), and on the policy's interval each node is asked to open and read its newest backup to the end so it can be shown as verified restorable.
